method: Actual distributed full-text reading by /root, /root/assets_sources, /root/systems_sources and /root/source_inventory. Every distinct complete byte buffer was fully exposed and processed by one or more readers. Exact duplicate aliases were attributed only after complete byte-buffer equality checks. Inventory and hashes did not count as reading. The root did not individually read every group.
scope: All 27 supplied top-level files, all 111 archive members in five containers including nested archives, all 133 text copies grouped into 91 exact full-content groups.
canonical_coverage_unit: Raw byte offsets, zero-based and end exclusive. Character receipts were mapped to raw-byte boundaries under their actual newline normalization policy.
